blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.
blocks.zh: 同时进行语音翻译(SimulST)需要平衡翻译质量和时间。 虽然大语言模型(LLMs)在离线翻译方面表现优异,但目前基于LLM的SimulST系统主要依赖于前缀增量生成. 这个范式存在冗余的密钥-Value缓存重算问题,需要外部语音活动检测来处理未绑定的流. 为了克服这些瓶颈,我们提议在全方位LLM的基础上建立一个端到端的互页读写框架。 通过切换语音块和文本符号,我们的架构实现了完整的 KV 缓存再利用, 本土支持无分割,无限长的推论. 此外,为了学习最佳的流线政策,而不僵硬的离线调整,我们引入了一个新的演员-批评自我增强管道。 一个RNN-T演员动态采样读写轨迹,而基于LLM的批评者通过内在的语义和时间性奖励来评价这些路径,将最佳政策提炼回演员. 关于句子一级(FLEURS, CoVoST2)和文件一级(MuST-C, ACL 60/60)基准的广泛实验表明,我们的模式建立了新的最先进的质量不老的帕雷托边界线,大大超过了现有的级联和静态调整基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) aims to incrementally translate a continuous audio stream while minimizing delivery latency. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized offline translation, deploying them for unbounded real-time speech reveals a fundamental architectural conflict. State-of-the-art SimulST approaches [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation [ 6 ] , where newly arrived speech chunks are continuously appended to the historical prefix. This invalidates the Key-Value (KV) cache across incremental steps, causing a quadratic computational explosion and forcing systems to rely on external Segmentation, such as Voice Activity Detection (VAD). Such forced segmentation disrupts cross-sentence context, impairs coreference resolution, and fails to natively support infinite-length streams.
blocks.zh: 同时期的语音翻译(SimulST)旨在逐渐翻译连续的音频流,同时尽量减少发送时空. 虽然大语言模型(LLMs)已革命性地将下线翻译化,但用于无约束的实时演讲的部署揭示了一个根本的建筑冲突. 最先进的SimulST方法[1,2,3,4,5]主要依靠前缀递增生成[6],其中新到的语音块连续附在历史前缀上. 这使键-Value(KV)缓存跨增量步骤失效,导致四极计算爆炸,迫使系统依赖外部分块,如语音活动检测(VAD). 这种强迫分化会扰乱交叉判决的背景,损害对齐的分辨率,并且无法在本土上支持无限长的溪流.

blocks.en: To bypass the KV cache bottleneck, recent studies explored interleaved read-write architectures [ 7 , 8 ] that append acoustic and textual tokens into a unified sequence. However, these models heavily depend on static, heuristic-driven word alignments (e.g., MFA [ 9 ] ) to construct supervised trajectories, failing to capture the dynamic, predictive nature of human interpreters. While some works adopt reinforcement learning [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] , they still require offline aligned data and struggle to scale multilingually. To address this, we propose CRESiST ( C ritic- R efined E xploratory Si multaneous S peech T ranslation), an interleaved framework that discovers its streaming policy without any external alignment supervision. Built on the Qwen2.5-omni-7B backbone [ 14 ] , CRESiST discards prefix-incremental generation and segmentation, achieving full KV cache reuse. Crucially, it operates at a granular 400ms micro-chunk size, enabling a highly fine-grained streaming policy.
blocks.zh: 为了绕过KV缓存瓶颈,最近的研究探索了将辅音符号和文字符号附加到统一序列中的互页读写架构[7,8]. 然而,这些模型严重依赖于静态的,热力驱动的词组对齐(例如,MFA[9])来构建有监督的轨迹,未能捕捉人类解释器的动态,预测性. 虽然有些工作采用强化学习[10,11,12,13],但它们仍然需要离线对齐的数据,并努力以多种语言进行推广。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出CRESiST(C ritic-R efined E xploratory S multatherine S pyech T ranslation),这是一个互离框架,在没有任何外部对齐监管的情况下发现其流政策. 建于Quen2.5-omni-7B主干线上 [14],CRESiST丢弃前缀增量生成和分区,实现 KV 缓存全重用. 关键的是,它以颗粒400ms微圆的尺寸运作,从而能够实行高度精细的流线政策。

blocks.en: To optimize this fine-grained policy without external alignments, we formulate the streaming decision process as a Markov Decision Process solved via a self-enhancing Actor-Critic pipeline. An auxiliary RNN-T acts as the Actor, actively exploring read-write trajectories. Simultaneously, the Speech LLM, equipped with an MoE Router and Refiner, serves as the Critic. The Critic evaluates trajectories using dynamic consistency and latency rewards, transferring its reward-maximizing preferences back to the Actor via reverse distillation. This iterative self-play allows CRESiST to autonomously discover adaptive, language-specific translation strategies (e.g., anticipating German verbs). Consequently, a single unified CRESiST model seamlessly translates Chinese and English streams into six diverse target languages.
blocks.zh: 为了在不进行外部调整的情况下优化这一精细调整的政策,我们制定了流程决策程序,作为通过自我增强的演员-批评管道解决的马可夫决策程序。 辅助RNN-T担任演员,积极探索读写轨迹. 同时,配有教育部路由器和炼油厂的LLM讲话成为批评者。 批评者利用动态一致性和耐久性奖励来评价轨迹,通过反向蒸馏将其奖励-最大化偏好转回演员. 这种迭代自演使得CRESiST能够自主地发现适应性的,语言特有的翻译策略(例如预测德语动词). 因此,一个统一的CRESiST模型将中文和英文流无缝地翻译成六种不同的目标语言。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Unsupervised Streaming Policy in an Interleaved Framework: While trained purely on offline parallel data, our framework autonomously transitions to an online interleaved paradigm, enabling full KV cache reuse for segmentation-free, infinite-length translation. • Fine-Grained Actor-Critic Policy Discovery: We introduce a novel self-enhancement pipeline operating at a 400ms acoustic chunk size. Through reward-driven reverse distillation, the model autonomously learns optimal streaming policies without static forced alignments. • Multilingual Generalization: A single unified CRESiST model supports Chinese/English inputs to six target languages, overcoming the limitations of language-pair-specific models. • State-of-the-Art Performance: Extensive experiments across sentence-level and unbounded document-level benchmarks demonstrate that CRESiST outperforms strong baselines (e.g., InfiniSST), establishing new Quality-Latency Pareto frontiers.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们的框架在纯粹接受离线平行数据培训的同时,自主地向在线互页模式过渡,使 KV 缓存能够全面重复使用,进行无分解、无限长的翻译。 • 优秀演员-批评政策发现: 我们引入了一个新的自我增强管道 运行在400ms的声积。 通过奖励驱动的反向蒸馏,该模型自主学习最佳流线政策,而无需静态强制调整. • 多语种通俗化: 单一统一的CRESiST模式支持6种目标语言的中英文输入,克服语言-pair特定模式的局限性. • 最新业绩:跨句子一级和无约束的文件一级基准的广泛试验表明,CRESiST超越了强有力的基线(例如InfiniSST),建立了新的质量-Latency Pareto边界。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Determining the optimal timing for translation is a core challenge in SimulST. A prevailing paradigm relies on static alignments from external tools (e.g., MFA) or probability mutations to construct supervised read-write trajectories [ 7 , 15 , 16 , 8 , 17 , 18 ] . To circumvent the rigidity of forced alignments, fixed and heuristic approaches utilize continuous integrate-and-fire (CIF) [ 19 ] , wait- k k cascades, or attention boundary indicators [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] . Recent unsupervised methods further explore dynamic boundary detection by leveraging offline-to-online inference divergence [ 4 , 5 ] , dual CIF distillation [ 24 ] , or implicit learning via mixture-of-experts [ 3 ] . Furthermore, to optimize the latency-quality trade-off beyond static supervision, advanced reinforcement learning techniques (such as PPO and GRPO) have been increasingly adopted to autonomously refine streaming translation strategies [ 11 , 13 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 确定翻译的最佳时机是SimulST中的一个核心挑战。 一个通行的范式依赖于来自外部工具(如外交部)的静态对齐或概率突变来构建受监督的读写轨迹[7,15,16,8,17,18]. 为避免强制调整的僵硬性,固定和弹性方法利用连续的集成和火力[19]、等待-k k级联,或注意边界指标[20、21、22、23]。 最近未经监督的方法进一步探索动态边界探测,利用线下到线的推断差异[4,5],双重CIF衍射[24],或通过专家混合[3]进行隐含学习. 此外,为了在静态监督之外优化延迟质量的取舍,越来越多地采用先进的强化学习技术(如PPO和GRPO)来自主完善流译战略[11,13,12].

blocks.en: Processing continuous, infinite-length audio streams typically suffers from severe memory bottlenecks. Traditional systems heavily depend on external segmenters like VAD or acoustic heuristics [ 25 ] , which inevitably disrupt cross-sentence contextual coherence. To mitigate this, recent studies have proposed history selection mechanisms that only retain fixed amounts of text tokens and their attention-covered acoustic frames [ 26 ] . Alternatively, formulating the continuous stream as multi-turn dialogues allows for the safe discarding of distant KV cache [ 7 ] ; however, such formulations typically mandate tightly coupled supervised policies to function effectively.
blocks.zh: 处理连续的,无限长的音频流通常会遇到严重的内存瓶颈. 传统系统严重依赖诸如VAD或声学heuristics[25]等外部分解器,这不可避免地会扰乱跨判决背景的一致性. 为了缓解这种情况,最近的研究提出了历史选择机制,只保留固定数量的文字符号及其所覆盖的注意声框[26]. 另一种办法是,将连续流编为多回合对话,可以安全地丢弃遥远的KV缓存[7];然而,这种提法通常要求严格结合的监管政策有效发挥作用。

blocks.en: 3.2 Actor-Critic Training Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 行为者-批评者培训框架

blocks.en: To solve the MDP formulated in the previous section and transition toward an autonomous read-write interleaved paradigm, we propose a self-enhancing Actor-Critic training framework, outlined in Algorithm 1 . Given an offline speech-text corpus 𝒟 = { ( 𝐒 , 𝐓 ) } \mathcal{D}=\{(\mathbf{S},\mathbf{T})\} , our framework jointly optimizes translation fidelity and the simultaneous streaming policy. By decoupling the generation process into an exploration-evaluation loop, we effectively compute the MDP transition dynamics and the reward function ℛ \mathcal{R} without relying on heuristic alignments.

We formally define the consistency reward as the negative log-likelihood of the generation targets: ℛ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y = − ( ℒ r ​ e ​ f ​ i ​ n ​ e ​ r + ℒ b ​ o ​ d ​ y ) \mathcal{R}_{consistency}=-(\mathcal{L}_{refiner}+\mathcal{L}_{body}) (1) where ℒ r ​ e ​ f ​ i ​ n ​ e ​ r \mathcal{L}_{refiner} and ℒ b ​ o ​ d ​ y \mathcal{L}_{body} are the cross-entropy generation losses of the Refiner and LLM body, respectively. High predictive accuracy yields a high consistency reward. 2) Latency Reward ( ℛ l ​ a ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{R}_{latency} ): To ensure timely responses without relying on heuristic constraints, the Router module assesses the sequence of hidden states to predict the action probability p k = Router ​ ( 𝐇 k − 1 , θ c ​ r ​ i ) p_{k}=\text{Router}(\mathbf{H}_{k-1};\theta_{cri}) at each step, where p k → 1 p_{k}\to 1 signifies a Read and p k → 0 p_{k}\to 0 signifies a Write . We mathematically formalize the latency reward as the expected length of consecutive text generation in a given turn. Since the probability of executing at least m m consecutive writes starting from step k k is given by the cumulative product of write probabilities, the expected write length 𝔼 ⁡ [ W k ] \mathbb{E}[W_{k}] can be elegantly formulated as: ℛ l ​ a ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y ( k ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ W k ] = ∑ m = 1 M ∏ j = 1 m ( 1 − p k + j ) \mathcal{R}_{latency}^{(k)}=\mathbb{E}[W_{k}]=\sum_{m=1}^{M}\prod_{j=1}^{m}\big(1-p_{k+j}\big) (2) where M M denotes the maximum allowable length for a single conversation turn. By maximizing this expectation-based reward, the Critic intrinsically incentivizes the policy to emit longer textual chunks as early as possible, thereby minimizing the overall translation delay. Essentially, the Critic judges whether the state-action path traversed by the Actor maximizes the overall reward ℛ = ℛ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y + γ ​ ℛ l ​ a ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{R}=\mathcal{R}_{consistency}+\gamma\mathcal{R}_{latency} , facilitating fluent generation with minimal delay.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 The Actor Model: Alignment Explorer
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 演员模式:对齐探索者

blocks.en: To avoid the computational inefficiency and "cold start" issues of rolling out interleaved sequences directly via the Speech LLM, the Actor is parameterized using an auxiliary Recurrent Neural Network Transducer (RNN-T).
blocks.zh: 为了避免直接通过Speech LLM推出互离序列的计算效率低下和"冷启动"问题,演员使用辅助的经常性神经网络转录器(RNN-T)参数化.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2(a) , our Actor comprises an acoustic encoder, a text predictor, and a joint network, augmented with a 2D axial attention module. Each layer of this axial attention module consists of two causal self-attention mechanisms—operating sequentially along the text and speech axes—followed by an MLP, strengthening dual-axis modality interaction.
blocks.zh: 如图2(a)所示,我们的演员包括一个声学编码器、一个文本预测器和一个联合网络,并增加了一个2D轴注意模块。 这一轴式注意单元的每一层都由两个因果自觉机制组成——沿文字和语音轴依次运作——接着是MLP,加强双轴模式相互作用。

blocks.en: For the specific configuration, the acoustic encoder is initialized with the pre-trained Whisper-medium encoder [ 28 ] , followed by two down-sampling M-Adapter layers to yield 2.5 Hz speech features (a 400ms window). A 400ms chunk-autoregressive mask is applied to strictly preserve causality. The text predictor and the axial attention module are initialized using the Qwen3-0.6B model, while the newly introduced audio-axis attention weights are initialized from scratch.
blocks.zh: 对于具体配置,声调编码器初始化后采用预训Whisper-medical编码器[28],然后采用两个向下取样的M-Adapter层来产生2.5Hz语音特性(一个400ms窗口). 400ms块自动递解面罩用于严格保存因果关系. 文本预测器和轴式注意力模块采用Quen3-0.6B模型初始化,而新引入的音频轴式注意力权重则从零开始初始化.

blocks.en: To construct the interleaved sequence 𝐳 \mathbf{z} defined in Section 3.2 , we traverse the ( T × U ) (T\times U) alignment lattice. At each node ( t , u ) (t,u) , the joint network outputs a blank (“Read”) emission probability p y ( t , u ) p_{y}^{(t,u)} . The routing action a k a_{k} is then directly sampled via: a k ∼ Bernoulli ​ ( p y ( t k , u k ) ) a_{k}\sim\text{Bernoulli}\big(p_{y}^{(t_{k},u_{k})}\big) (6) The sampled path 𝐚 = ( a 1 , … , a K ) \mathbf{a}=(a_{1},\dots,a_{K}) governs the lattice coordinate updates and dictates the exact merge boundaries for the LLM input space. Note that every sampled trajectory is a monotonic path on the lattice from ( 0 , 0 ) (0,0) to ( T , U ) (T,U) : a blank advances only along the audio axis and a token emission only along the text axis, and once the last audio chunk is reached all remaining target tokens are emitted. Every trajectory therefore contains exactly U U Write actions, so no target token is ever dropped from 𝐳 \mathbf{z} .

blocks.en: 3.3.2 The Critic Model: Speech LLM and Validator
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 批评模型:发言LLM和验证器

blocks.en: The Critic evaluates the Actor’s trajectories and generates the final translation. It is built upon a Qwen-omni Large Language Model backbone, structurally augmented with Router and Refiner modules.
blocks.zh: 批评者评价演员的轨迹并生成最终翻译. 它以Qunni-omni大语言模型主干线为基础,在结构上增加了路由器和炼油器模块。

blocks.en: Adapted from the “thinker” component of the Qwen2.5-omni-7B, the speech encoder is modified for streaming by applying a windowed chunk autoregressive mask (400ms chunk size, 20-chunk local attention window, yielding an 8-second receptive field). Cyclic sinusoidal positional encodings are applied every 2 seconds.
blocks.zh: 改编自Quen2.5-omni-7B的“思维器”组件,语音编码器通过应用一个窗口块自递式口罩(400ms块大小,20圆块局部注意力窗口,产生8秒的可接受字段)进行流化修改. 环辛基偶联定位编码每2秒应用一次.

blocks.en: The input is formatted using a multi-turn dialogue template. Task-level directives are embedded in the system prompt, and each audio chunk with its interleaved textual actions serves as a single conversational turn. The backbone processes this to yield local hidden states 𝐇 = LLM ​ ( 𝐳 , θ c ​ r ​ i ) \mathbf{H}=\text{LLM}(\mathbf{z};\theta_{cri}) and a globally compressed acoustic representation 𝐡 g ​ l ​ o ​ b ​ a ​ l = AvePool ​ ( LLM ​ ( 𝐒 , θ c ​ r ​ i ) ) \mathbf{h}_{global}=\text{AvePool}(\text{LLM}(\mathbf{S};\theta_{cri})) .

blocks.en: We adopt the Refiner architecture [ 3 ] for final generation. As shown in Figure 2(b) , the core structural integration involves repurposing the Router’s probability output p p as a dynamic routing scalar. The Refiner directly scales the global acoustic gain by p p and the local acoustic gain by ( 1 − p ) (1-p) . This self-adaptive gating synchronizes the generation context with the streaming timing state before the refined features are projected to compute the consistency reward ( ℛ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{R}_{consistency} ). blocks.en: 4 Experiment and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: To support multilingual translation, we aggregate three open-source ASR datasets: Emilia [ 29 ] , WenetSpeech [ 30 ] , and GigaSpeech [ 31 ] . We utilize the Qwen3-235B-A22B 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 model to generate pseudo-labels for the transcribed texts, translating them into Chinese, English, and the other 4 European languages (DE, FR, ES, IT). (Chinese and English account for more than 50% of the pseudo-labels). We augment WenetSpeech and GigaSpeech by concatenating consecutive clips into long segments of a maximum of 30 seconds. All training stages dynamically sample from this unified corpus for training and validation.
blocks.zh: 为了支持多语种翻译,我们汇总了三个开源ASR数据集:Emilia [29],wenetSpeech [30],和Gigaspeech [31]. 我们使用Quen3-235B-A22B 1 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Quen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 模式为转录文本生成伪标签,将其翻译为中文,英文,以及其他4种欧洲语言(DE,FR,ES,IT). (中英文占伪标签的50%以上). 我们通过将连续的片段压缩成最长30秒的长片段来增强WenetSpeech和GigaSpeech. 所有培训阶段都从这个统一的培训和鉴定机构中动态抽样。

blocks.en: Our training pipeline is implemented using PyTorch Lightning. The Speech LLM is parameter-efficiently fine-tuned using LoRA [ 32 ] with a rank of r = 16 r=16 . When training the LLM for SimulST task, we also train offline ST and MT tasks in a multi-task way to preserve offline performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练管道使用PyTorch闪电进行。 Speech LLM的参数效率微调使用LORA [32],级别为r=16r=16. 在为SimulST任务训练LLM时,我们也以多任务的方式训练离线ST和MT任务,以保持离线性能.

blocks.en: Following our proposed Actor-Critic paradigm, the training strictly proceeds in three stages: 1) Actor Pre-training: The auxiliary RNN-T Aligner is trained with the standard RNN-T loss to establish basic acoustic-linguistic alignments. Only the alignment task itself is new at this stage: the acoustic encoder is initialized from Whisper-medium, and the text-axis attention and MLP of each axial layer inherit the corresponding Qwen3-0.6B layer (the bottom 12 layers are frozen and receive no audio-axis attention; the upper 16 layers are augmented), while the audio-axis attention and the joint network are randomly initialized. 2) Critic Pre-training: Freezing the RNN-T parameters, we use its sampled trajectories to construct interleaved sequences. The Speech LLM (including the Router and Refiner) is optimized to adapt to this streaming input format. 3) Joint Self-Enhancement: All modules are unfrozen. The framework undergoes joint training via reverse distillation (as detailed in Section 3.2 ), continuously refining the Actor’s sampling policy alongside the Critic’s generation capability.
blocks.zh: 按照我们提议的演员-批评模式,培训严格分三个阶段进行: (1) 演员前培训: 辅助RNN-T Aligner用标准的RNN-T损失进行训练,以建立基本的声学-语言对齐. 只有对齐任务本身在这一阶段是新的:声调编码器从Whisper-medic中初始化,每个轴层的文本轴注意和MLP继承相应的Qwen3-0.6B层(底部12层被冻结,没有得到音频轴注意;上部16层被放大),而音频轴注意和联合网络则随机初始化. (2) 批判前培训: 冻结RNN-T参数,我们利用它的样本轨迹来构建互离序列. Speech LLM(包括路由器和炼油器)被优化,以适应这种流式输入格式. (3) 联合自我加强: 所有模块解冻. 该框架通过反向蒸馏(详见第3.2节)进行联合培训,不断完善演员的取样政策以及批评者的生成能力。

blocks.en: Actor Pre-training: The auxiliary RNN-T Aligner is trained with the standard RNN-T loss to establish basic acoustic-linguistic alignments. Only the alignment task itself is new at this stage: the acoustic encoder is initialized from Whisper-medium, and the text-axis attention and MLP of each axial layer inherit the corresponding Qwen3-0.6B layer (the bottom 12 layers are frozen and receive no audio-axis attention; the upper 16 layers are augmented), while the audio-axis attention and the joint network are randomly initialized.
blocks.zh: 培训前: 辅助RNN-T Aligner用标准的RNN-T损失进行训练,以建立基本的声学-语言对齐. 只有对齐任务本身在这一阶段是新的:声调编码器从Whisper-medic中初始化,每个轴层的文本轴注意和MLP继承相应的Qwen3-0.6B层(底部12层被冻结,没有得到音频轴注意;上部16层被放大),而音频轴注意和联合网络则随机初始化.

blocks.en: Critic Pre-training: Freezing the RNN-T parameters, we use its sampled trajectories to construct interleaved sequences. The Speech LLM (including the Router and Refiner) is optimized to adapt to this streaming input format.
blocks.zh: 批判前培训: 冻结RNN-T参数,我们利用它的样本轨迹来构建互离序列. Speech LLM(包括路由器和炼油器)被优化,以适应这种流式输入格式.

blocks.en: Joint Self-Enhancement: All modules are unfrozen. The framework undergoes joint training via reverse distillation (as detailed in Section 3.2 ), continuously refining the Actor’s sampling policy alongside the Critic’s generation capability.
blocks.zh: 联合自强: 所有模块解冻. 该框架通过反向蒸馏(详见第3.2节)进行联合培训,不断完善演员的取样政策以及批评者的生成能力。

blocks.en: We evaluate our model across diverse streaming scenarios. For sentence-level evaluation , we utilize the FLEURS [ 33 ] and CoVoST 2 [ 34 ] datasets across the 10 supported directions. Notably, on FLEURS, we decouple the evaluation into Chinese-English bidirectional translations (to ensure a direct comparison with Seed-LiveInterpret2) and the remaining 8 directions. For document-level continuous streaming , we utilize the MuST-C and ACL6060 test sets (En-Zh, En-De). We use OmniSTEval for long-form evaluation. 2 2 2 https://github.com/pe-trik/OmniSTEval/tree/main
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们的模式,涵盖不同的流派情景。 在判刑一级评价中,我们使用FLEURS[33]和CoVoST 2[34]数据集,跨越10个支助方向。 值得注意的是,在FLEURS上,我们把评价分解为中英文双向翻译(以确保与种子-Live Interpret2直接比较)和其余8个方向. 对于文件级连续流线,我们使用MuST-C和ACL6060测试集(En-Zh,En-De)。 我们使用OmniSTEval进行长式评价。

blocks.en: We benchmark our framework against strong state-of-the-art systems, including open-source foundations ( Seamless Streaming ), commercial SOTA Seed-LiveInterpret2 , and academic simultaneous models ( AlignATT , StreamUni , InfiniSST ). More details about the baseline implementation can be found in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们参照最先进的系统,包括开源基础(无缝流)、商业SOTA种子-Live Interpret2和学术同步模型(AligNAT、StreamUni、InfiniSST)。 有关基准执行情况的更多详情见附录C.3。

blocks.en: Simultaneous translation requires balancing translation fidelity and streaming latency. For Translation Quality, we utilize XCOMET-XXL 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Unbabel/XCOMET-XXL , a neural metric that aligns significantly better with human judgments compared to traditional n-gram metrics [ 35 ] . For Streaming Latency , we apply input-adaptive metrics to avoid heuristic bias: we report the Length-Adaptive Acoustic Latency ( LAAL ) [ 36 ] for sentence-level benchmarks, and adopt the recently proposed LongYAAL metric for document-level evaluations to accurately capture the cumulative delays in continuous long-form audio streams [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 同声翻译需要平衡翻译忠贞度和流畅的延迟度. 关于翻译质量,我们使用XCOMET-XXL 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Unbabel/XCOMET-XXL,这一神经计量与人类判断相比,比传统的n克度量更吻合 [35] 。 对于流线性(Streaming Latency),我们采用输入适应性度量衡来避免恒定性偏差:我们为句子级基准报告长线性声频性(LAAL)[36],并采用最近为文件级评价提议的长线性(LongYAAL)度量,以准确记录连续长线形音频流的累积延迟[37].

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates the quality-latency Pareto frontiers on the CoVoST2 and FLEURS benchmarks. By varying the decision threshold (e.g., τ ∈ [ 0.3 , 0.7 ] \tau\in[0.3,0.7] ), we plot the translation quality against the latency metric. Our proposed framework consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier, dominating both Seamless Streaming and AlignATT across all latency regimes. Notably, on the FLEURS (zh ↔ \leftrightarrow en) benchmark, our streaming model strictly outperforms the commercial Seed LiveInterpret 2.0 API, achieving higher translation quality while maintaining a comparable or superior latency profile. Furthermore, the curve demonstrates that our model degrades gracefully at extremely low latency requirements (e.g., LAAL < 1.5 <1.5 ), proving the effectiveness of the reverse-distilled streaming policy.
blocks.zh: 图3显示了CoVoST2和FLEURS基准上的质量相关性帕雷托边界。 通过改变决定阈值(例如\\\\\\[0.3,0.7]\tau\in[0.3,0.7]),我们根据延迟度量来绘制翻译质量. 我们提出的框架始终如一地建立了一个新的、最先进的边界,在所有临时政权中都占据着无海流和AlignATT。 值得注意的是,在FLEURS(zh QQ\ left rightarrow en)基准上,我们的流线模型严格地超过了商业Seed Live Interpret 2.0 API,实现了更高的翻译质量,同时保持了可比较或优异的延迟配置. 此外,曲线显示,我们的模型在极低的延迟要求(例如LAAL < 1.5 < 1.5)下优雅地降解,证明了逆向漂流政策的有效性。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Sentence-level quality-latency trade-off curves on the CoVoST2 and FLEURS datasets. The proposed framework consistently establishes a superior Pareto frontier compared to Seamless Streaming and AlignATT across all sub-tasks.
blocks.zh: 图3: CoVoST2和FLEURS数据集上的句法级质量相关性权衡曲线. 拟议的框架在所有次级任务中,始终确定一个比无缝流动和AlignATT更好的Pareto边界。

blocks.en: Evaluating on isolated sentences often obscures the compounding errors inherent in real-world, long-form translation. Table 1 presents our results on the MuST-C and ACL 60/60 benchmarks across three settings: Offline w/ Oracle Segmentation , Streaming w/ Oracle Segmentation , and the most rigorous Streaming w/o Segmentation . The contrast between the latter two settings effectively reveals a model’s true capacity to process continuous, unbounded audio streams.
blocks.zh: 在孤立的句子上评价往往掩盖现实世界长式翻译中固有的复杂错误。 表1列出了我们关于MuST-C和ACL 60/60基准的结果,这些基准涵盖三个环境:离线w/甲骨文分流、流线w/甲骨文分流和最严格的流线w/o分流。 后两种设置之间的对比有效地揭示了一个模型处理连续的,无约束的音频流的真正能力.

blocks.en: Notably, while InfiniSST is explicitly designed for infinite audio streams, it exhibits a paradoxical performance drop when evaluated at the sentence level with oracle boundaries. In contrast, CRESiST delivers consistently high performance across both streaming scenarios. Strikingly, our unsegmented streaming performance closely trails the oracle segmentation with a marginal degradation of only 1–2 COMET points, demonstrating that CRESiST can flawlessly manage infinite context without relying on explicit segmentation.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,虽然InfiniSST明确是为无限音频流设计的,但当在句子层面用甲骨文边界进行评价时,它表现出矛盾的性能下降. 与此相反,CRESiST在两种流化情景中都提供一贯的高性能。 令人振奋的是,我们无隔断的流线性能紧跟着甲骨文分裂,只有1–2个彗星点的边缘降解,表明CRESiST可以完美无缺地管理无限的上下文,而不依赖于明显的分割.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we observe that offline incremental methods such as StreamATT serve as highly competitive baselines on certain language pairs. However, their performance is notably inconsistent; on other language pairs, historical context selection leads to a catastrophic drop in translation quality (e.g., on the ACL 60/60 en-de dataset, the COMET score plummets from 80.83 under oracle segmentation to 70.61) coupled with severe latency inflation. Ultimately, CRESiST successfully navigates infinite audio streams, avoiding the pitfalls of historical amnesia and alignment drift while maintaining state-of-the-art translation quality and minimal continuous delay. CRESiST is also complementary to RL-based policy optimization: GRPO post-training further improves it, whereas the same recipe cannot close the gap from a direct-SFT base (Appendix D.1 ).
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还注意到,StreamATT等离线增量方法可作为某些语文对的高度竞争性基线。 然而,它们的性能明显不一致;在其他语言配对中,历史背景选择导致翻译质量的灾难性下降(例如ACL 60/60 en-de数据集中,彗星分数从甲骨文分数下的80.83下降到70.61),同时伴有严重的延迟通货膨胀. 最终,CRESiST成功导航无限音频流,避免了历史失忆和对齐漂移的陷阱,同时保持了最先进的翻译质量和最小的持续延迟. CRESiST也是基于RL的政策优化的补充: GRPO的后期培训进一步改善了这种培训,而同样的方法无法从直接的SFT基础中弥补差距(附录D.1)。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Document-level simultaneous translation performance on the MuST-C and ACL 60/60 benchmarks. The COMET is evaluated through XCOMET-XXL. Our proposed CRESiST model achieves state-of-the-art translation quality with minimal continuous delay, demonstrating exceptional robustness in the challenging unsegmented streaming scenario. Oracle Segmentation denotes sentence-level segmentation taken from the native sentence timestamps of the test sets, i.e., inference is run independently on each human-segmented sentence.
blocks.zh: 表1:MuST-C和ACL60/60基准上的文件一级同步翻译业绩。 通过XCOMET-XXL对彗星进行评估。 我们提议的CRESiST模式实现了最先进的翻译质量,而且持续拖延时间很少,这表明在挑战性的无分界线的流派情景中,它异常有力。 甲骨文分解(Oracle Specification)是指从测试集的原生句子时间戳上提取的句子层次分解,即推断在每一个人块分解的句子上独立运行.

blocks.en: 5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5 阅读研究

blocks.en: 5.1 Effect of Training Strategies
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训战略的效果

blocks.en: We first investigate the impact of our self-enhancing Actor-Critic training paradigm. Figure 4 presents the quality-latency trade-offs under different training strategies. For fairness, the training steps are kept identical. The baseline (“Stage 1 & Direct SFT”), which directly utilizes RNN-T aligned data for Supervised Fine-Tuning akin to the approach in InfiniSST, yields the poorest performance. It struggles to run at a granularity of 400 milliseconds (latency multiplier=1). The pipeline approach (“Stage 1 & 2”), which trains the modules sequentially without the final joint optimization, shows noticeable improvements over the direct SFT.
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查我们自我增强的演员-批评者培训模式的影响。 图4列示了不同培训战略下的质量相关性权衡。 为了公平起见,培训步骤保持不变。 直接利用RNN-T对齐数据的基线(“标准1和直接SFT”)与InfiniSST中的方法类似,使业绩最差。 它很难在400毫秒的颗粒度(纬度乘数=1)下运行. 管道方法(“第1和第2段”)在不进行最后联合优化的情况下依次对模块进行培训,显示出与直接SFT相比的明显改进。

blocks.en: In contrast, our full CRESiST framework with joint self-enhancement achieves the best overall Pareto frontier. The improvement is particularly pronounced on the Chinese-English (zh ↔ \leftrightarrow en) pairs, where the overall latency is significantly reduced while maintaining high translation quality.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,通过联合自我加强,我们的CRESiST全面框架实现了整个帕雷托边界的最佳目标。 中英(zh QQ\\rightarrow en)对子的改进尤为明显,在保持高翻译质量的同时,整体延迟性显著降低.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Ablation on training strategies. “Direct SFT” uses RNN-T aligned data directly (similar to InfiniSST). “Stage 1 & 2” represents pipeline training without the final joint optimization. “CRESiST” indicates our full joint training framework, which yields the most significant latency reduction, particularly on resource-rich directions (e.g., zh ↔ \leftrightarrow en).
blocks.zh: 图4:培训战略方面的考虑。 “直接SFT”直接使用RNN-T对齐数据(类似于InfiniSST)。 “第1和第2阶段”是指未进行最后联合优化的管道培训。 “CRESiST”表示我们的全面联合培训框架,它产生最显著的暂时性减少,特别是在资源丰富的方向上(例如zh ↔\\\\ left rightarrow en)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Sensitivity to the Latency Penalty Weight
blocks.zh: 5.2 对轻度处罚的敏感性

blocks.en: Next, as a sensitivity analysis rather than an ablation, we examine the impact of the latency penalty hyperparameter α \alpha on the system, with all variants trained for an identical number of steps. As illustrated in Figure 5 , α \alpha explicitly governs the trade-off between translation quality and streaming latency. As expected, when α \alpha is large, the model aggressively penalizes delays, resulting in a compressed, lower overall latency profile, but at the cost of relatively degraded translation quality. Conversely, an excessively small α \alpha fails to adequately constrain the streaming policy, leading to disproportionately high latency spikes at specific decision thresholds.
blocks.zh: 其次,作为灵敏度分析而不是减速分析,我们研究了延缓性速率超参数α-α对系统的影响,所有变体都接受了相同数量的阶梯训练. 如图5所示,α-α明确规定了翻译质量与流转间隔之间的权衡。 如预期,当α-α大时,该模型会严厉惩罚延迟,导致压缩、降低总体延迟状况,但代价是翻译质量相对下降。 相反,过小的α-α未能充分限制流转政策,导致在具体决定阈值上超乎寻常地上升。

blocks.en: 5.3 Actor Architecture: Axial Blocks vs. Conventional RNN-T
blocks.zh: 5.3 演员建筑:轴板块对常规RNN-T

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate the architectural design of our auxiliary RNN-T Actor by comparing our proposed model (incorporating 2D axial attention blocks) against a conventional RNN-T architecture. We assess the alignment quality on the validation set using two metrics: the perplexity (PPL, base e e ) of the emitted target text and the Average Lagging (AL, measured in seconds) of the generated interleaved sequence. [ 38 ]
blocks.zh: 最后,我们评价我们辅助的RNN-T Actor的建筑设计,将我们拟议的模型(包含2D轴心区块)与传统的RNN-T建筑进行比较. 我们使用两个衡量标准来评估一组验证的校正质量:所排放的目标文本的模糊性(PPL,基础e e)和生成的互离序列的平均拉线(AL,以秒计)。 [38]

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 2 , both the two checkpoints are trained for 600k steps. The conventional RNN-T struggles significantly to produce optimal read-write paths, exhibiting abnormally high latency (AL = 8.03s) and poor text generation confidence (PPL = 22.3). The inclusion of axial blocks effectively strengthens the interaction between audio and text modalities, drastically improving alignment behavior. This design successfully drops the PPL to 6.03 and reduces the average lagging to 1.81s, providing a much higher-quality interleaved sequence for the downstream Speech LLM. We further verify in Appendix D.2 that the Actor is effective as a policy explorer but not as the final translator: reverse distillation transfers its latency behavior, while its translation quality stays far below the Speech LLM.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced a novel self-enhancing Actor-Critic framework designed to transition simultaneous speech translation from rigid, incremental processing to a dynamic, read-write interleaved paradigm. By decoupling policy exploration and reward evaluation, our method empowers an auxiliary RNN-T Actor to construct optimal streaming trajectories, while the Speech LLM Critic leverages its Router-Refiner module to ensure high-fidelity generation. Through a closed-loop reverse distillation mechanism, the framework autonomously aligns the streaming policy with the LLM’s generation rhythm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency trade-offs across both sentence-level and challenging document-level benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了一个新的自我增强的演员-批评框架,旨在将同步语音翻译从刚性,递增的处理过渡到动态的,读取的互页范式. 通过脱钩政策探索和奖励评价,我们的方法赋予了辅助RNN-T演员构建最佳流线轨迹的权力,而Speech LLM Critic则利用其路由器-Refinner模块来确保高纯度生成. 通过闭路反向蒸馏机制,框架将流线政策与LLM的生成节奏自动协调. 广泛的实验表明,我们的办法在判决一级和具有挑战性的文件一级基准之间建立了最新质量相关性的权衡。

blocks.en: Despite the promising results, our framework exhibits a few limitations that warrant future investigation:
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了有希望的成果,但我们的框架显示出一些局限性,值得今后进行调查:

blocks.en: • Data and Domain Bottlenecks: As this work primarily focuses on streaming policy optimization, we didn’t perform rigorous data engineering. The absolute translation quality is fundamentally bottlenecked by the backbone capacity and offline SFT data, which sub-optimally affect overall performance. For example, we observed an offline performance drop on the ACL60/60 dev set compared to the vanilla Qwen2.5-omni model, indicating domain distribution discrepancies and catastrophic forgetting in specialized academic domains. • Document-level Latency Control: While adjusting the decision threshold ( τ \tau ) effectively modulates the sentence-level quality-latency trade-off, it yields marginal tuning effects during document-level continuous streaming. Regulating the compounding dynamics of infinite audio streams likely requires dynamic penalty mechanisms, such as the context-aware latency multiplier utilized in InfiniSST, rather than relying solely on a static probability threshold.
blocks.zh: • 数据与域块: 由于这项工作主要集中于流政策优化,我们没有进行严格的数据工程。 绝对翻译质量从根本上受到骨干能力和离线SFT数据的束缚,对整体性能影响不大. 例如,我们看到ACL60/60dev集与香草Quen2.5-omni模型相比的离线性能下降,表明域分布差异和在专业学术领域的灾难性遗忘. • 文件级 延迟控制 : 在调整决定阈值(\\tau)有效调节句子级别质量相关性权衡的同时,它在文件级别连续流时会产生边际调理效果. 管制无限音频流的复合动态可能要求动态惩罚机制,如InfiniSST中使用的上下文认知延时乘数,而不是完全依赖静态概率阈值.

blocks.en:
To prevent routing collapse in our two-expert Refiner architecture and maintain numerical stability, we adopt a lightweight, combined load-balancing loss. We first define a squared soft margin penalty, ℳ ⁡ ( v , a , b ) \mathcal{M}(v;a,b) , which continuously penalizes a variable v v when it deviates from a target interval [ a , b ] [a,b] : ℳ ⁡ ( v , a , b ) = { ( a − v ) 2 , if ​ v < a ( v − b ) 2 , if ​ v > b 0 , otherwise \mathcal{M}(v;a,b)=\begin{cases}(a-v)^{2},&\text{if }v<a\\
(v-b)^{2},&\text{if }v>b\\
0,&\text{otherwise}\end{cases} (12) This squared formulation ensures smooth, differentiable gradients at the boundaries.

Given a batch of N N tokens, let x i x_{i} denote the raw routing logit for the i i -th token, and p i = σ ⁡ ( x i ) p_{i}=\sigma(x_{i}) be its probability of being routed to the first expert. Let p ¯ = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N p i \bar{p}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}p_{i} represent the batch-averaged routing probability. Our overall balancing loss, L b ​ a ​ l L_{bal} , simultaneously regularizes the micro-level logits to prevent Sigmoid saturation and constrains the macro-level routing probabilities to ensure equitable expert utilization: L b ​ a ​ l ​ a ​ n ​ c ​ e = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N ℳ ⁡ ( x i , − 5 , 5 ) + ℳ ⁡ ( p ¯ , 0.3 , 0.7 ) L_{balance}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathcal{M}(x_{i};-5,5)+\mathcal{M}(\bar{p};0.3,0.7) (13) By softly bounding individual logits within [ − 5 , 5 ] [-5,5] and the average routing probability within [ 0.3 , 0.7 ] [0.3,0.7] , the model mathematically guarantees statistical load balancing while preserving token-level routing flexibility.

blocks.en: For sentence-level inference, we utilized Voice Activity Detection (VAD) exclusively to truncate initial silence at the beginning of audio clips. Acoustic features were continuously extracted using a 400ms window. The KV cache for both the acoustic prefix and the generated text tokens was dynamically maintained and incrementally updated. To minimize inference latency, we adopted a greedy decoding strategy coupled with a windowed 4-gram no-repeat logits processor to prevent degenerative repetitions. All reported latency metrics—for both our proposed method and the baselines—were computed at the word level (or character level for CJK languages).

blocks.en: D.1 Compatibility with RL-based Policy Optimization
blocks.zh: D.1 与基于可再生能源的政策的兼容性

blocks.en: CRESiST is an SFT-time policy-discovery framework: translation is still learned by supervised maximum likelihood on the offline corpus, while the read-write policy is discovered by the Actor-Critic loop. It is therefore complementary to, rather than a substitute for, RL-based policy optimization, and the resulting model is a valid starting point for subsequent RL. To verify this, we apply GRPO on top of CRESiST following the reward design of HPO [ 13 ] . For reference, we apply the same recipe to an InfiniSST-style SFT baseline trained on the same Qwen2.5-Omni backbone with RNN-T aligned data (the “Direct SFT” setting of Section 5 ). CRESiST+GRPO is trained for 700 steps on the multilingual corpus, and SFT+GRPO for 1000 steps on En-Zh. Table 3 reports document-level En-Zh results in the streaming w/o segmentation setting.
blocks.zh: CRESiST是一个SFT时的政策发现框架:翻译在离线程序上仍然通过监督的最大可能性来学习,而读写政策则通过演员-批评循环来发现. 因此,它补充而不是取代基于RL的政策优化,由此产生的模式是后续RL的有效起点. 为了证实这一点,我们根据HPO的奖励设计,在CRESiST之上应用GRPO[13]. 为了参考起见,我们把同样的食谱应用于在相同的Quen2.5-Omni主干线上训练的InfiniSST型SFT基线(第5节的“Direct SFT”设置)。 CRESiST+GRPO接受关于多语种教程的700个步骤的培训,SFT+GRPO接受关于En-Zh的1 000个步骤的培训。

blocks.en: Three observations follow. (1) CRESiST is fully compatible with RL: GRPO further improves it on both benchmarks (e.g., +4.7 COMET on MuST-C) without hurting latency. (2) RL does not compensate for a weak SFT base: CRESiST without any RL already outperforms SFT+GRPO by a clear margin in both quality and latency, so SFT-time policy learning remains meaningful even when RL post-training is available. (3) Our GRPO gains are smaller than those reported in the HPO paper, which we attribute to the stronger starting point. We also note that after GRPO post-training the model streams raw audio stably without the VAD pause filtering described in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 以下三项意见。 (1) CRESiST与RL完全兼容:GRPO在两个基准上进一步改进(例如:+4.7 Comet on MuST-C)而不会损害耐久性. (2)RL不能补偿薄弱的SFT基础:没有RL的CRESiST在质量和耐久性上都已经明显超过SFT+GRPO,因此SFT时间政策学习即使在RL后培训时仍然有意义. (3) 我们的GRPO收益小于HPO文件中所报告的收益,我们将此归因于更强大的起点. 我们亦注意到GRPO训练后,

blocks.en: D.2 The RNN-T Actor as an Inference Model
blocks.zh: D.2 作为推论模型的RNN-T演员

blocks.en: A natural question is whether the self-enhancement loop improves the RNN-T Actor enough for it to serve as the final inference model on its own, which would also quantify how much of the final performance is contributed by the Speech LLM. Our Actor is itself a complete simultaneous translation model trained on the same data (Whisper-medium encoder, Qwen3-0.6B predictor with axial attention, and a joint network), so we decode it directly with streaming greedy decoding (blank = Read, non-blank = Write), both before (Stage 1) and after (Stage 3) reverse distillation. Table 4 reports sentence-level results on FLEURS.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,自我增强循环是否改进了RNN-T actor,使其足以单独作为最终推论模型,这也可以量化Speech LLM贡献了多少最终性能. 我们的演员本身就是一个完全同步的翻译模型,在同一个数据(Whisper-medical encoder, Qune3-0.6B 预测器具有轴心注意,以及联合网络)上训练,因此我们直接用流线贪婪的解码(blank = Read,非blank = Rewrite)来解码,无论是在(第1版)之前还是(第3版)之后的反向蒸馏. 表4报告了FLEURS的句子级结果。

blocks.en: Table 4: Using the RNN-T Actor directly as the inference model on FLEURS (XCOMET-XXL ↑ \uparrow / LAAL ↓ \downarrow ), before and after reverse distillation, compared with the full CRESiST Speech LLM.
blocks.zh: 表4:在反向蒸馏前后,直接使用RNN-T演员作为FLEURS(XCOMET-XXL ↑ \ \ \ \ ↑ ↑ ↑ ↑ ↑)的推论模型,与完整的CRESiST Speech LLM相比.

blocks.en: The results confirm that the RNN-T is effective as an Actor but unsuitable as the final translator. Reverse distillation transfers the policy , not the quality: the Actor’s COMET is essentially unchanged, while its latency drops markedly (Zh-En LAAL 2.29s → \rightarrow 1.52s, close to that of the Speech LLM), showing that its read/write behavior has been aligned with the Critic. Its translation quality, however, remains 33–37 XCOMET points below the Speech LLM; the RNN-T decides reliably when to translate, but its 0.6B predictor lacks the linguistic and world knowledge needed for what to generate, with named-entity hallucinations being the dominant failure mode. The RNN-T is also an inefficient inference model: each step evaluates the joint network along an entire row or column of the ( T × U ) (T\times U) lattice, so its decoding cost grows with the product of the audio and text lengths rather than with the sequence length, and scaling the transducer toward the 7B class would multiply this lattice cost while still lacking pretrained LLM knowledge. These results cleanly separate the two roles in our framework, where the Actor supplies the policy and the Speech LLM supplies the quality, and justify keeping a small RNN-T as the policy explorer paired with a pretrained Speech LLM as the generator.
blocks.zh: 结果证实RNN-T作为演员是有效的,但作为最后的翻译是不合适的. 反向蒸馏转移了政策,而不是质量:演员的彗星基本上没有变化,而它的潜伏度则明显下降(Zh-En LAAL 2.29s →\rightarrow 1.52s,接近Speech LLM),表明其读写行为已经与批评者一致. 然而,它的翻译质量仍然低于Speech LLM的33–37 XCOMET点;RNN-T可靠地决定何时翻译,但其0.6B的预测器缺乏生成所需的语言和世界知识,以命名实体幻觉为主的失败模式. RNN-T也是一个效率低下的推论模型:每一步沿(T××U)(T\times U)拉蒂采的整行或列评价联合网络,因此其解码成本随着音频和文本长度的产物而不是序列长度的增加而增加,向7B类的调制器会使这种拉蒂采的成本倍增,同时仍然缺乏经过预先训练的LLM知识. 这些结果将我们框架中的两个角色明确区分开来,在这个框架中,演员提供政策,而Speech LLM提供质量,并证明保留一个小型的RNN-T作为政策探索者与经过预先培训的Speech LLM配对成为生成者是合理的.

blocks.en: Appendix E Case Visualization
blocks.zh: 附录E 案例可视化

blocks.en: In this section, we present case visualizations to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed framework from two distinct perspectives: the internal alignment quality of our speech-text aligner, and the overall end-to-end translation latency.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提出可视化案例,以从两个不同的角度展示我们拟议框架的有效性:我们的语音文本校正器的内部校正质量,以及整个端到端翻译的延迟性。

blocks.en: E.1 Analysis of RNN-T Alignment Quality
blocks.zh: E.1 对RNN-T对齐质量的分析

blocks.en: First, we examine the internal behavior of our proposed RNN-T aligner. Figure 6 visualizes the emission probabilities and the resulting decoding paths for both the proposed RNN-T (with axial attention) and a conventional RNN-T on a specific translation case.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们审查我们提议的RNN-T对齐器的内部行为。 图6可视化拟议的RNN-T(具有轴心注意)和关于具体翻译案例的常规RNN-T的排放量概率和由此产生的解码路径。

blocks.en: As explicitly shown in Figure 6(b) , the conventional RNN-T struggles to confidently predict the necessary text tokens during the ongoing speech stream. Due to this failure in timely token emission, it cannot establish a proper incremental alignment. Consequently, the decoding path is forced to delay the majority of its predictions until the very end of the speech input (around chunk 33), effectively degenerating the system into an offline translation paradigm.
blocks.zh: 如图6(b)所示,传统的RNN-T在进行中的语音流中难以自信地预测必要的文本符号。 由于未能及时进行象征性排放,因此无法建立适当的递增调整。 因此,解码路径被迫将其大多数预测延迟到语音输入的结束之时(大约第33块),有效地将系统分解为离线翻译范式.

blocks.en: In contrast, our proposed RNN-T (Figure 6(a) ) overcomes this critical limitation. It yields significantly sharper and more concentrated emission probabilities, successfully predicting tokens as the speech stream unfolds. This distinct, high-quality monotonic decoding path demonstrates that our approach effectively maintains the incremental alignment required for true simultaneous translation, avoiding the offline degradation seen in the conventional baseline.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们提议的RNN-T(图6(a))克服了这一关键限制。 它产生显著的更尖锐和更集中的排放概率,随着语音流的展开,成功预测了信号符. 这种独特的高质量单调编码路径表明,我们的方法有效地保持了真正同时翻译所需的增量对齐,避免了常规基线中看到的离线退化。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Translation timing visualization for a sample from the FLEURS EN-ZH test set. The timeline illustrates the latency advantage of our model, which performs fine-grained, word-level adaptive translation, in contrast to the coarse-grained, clause-level buffering strategy employed by the Seed LiveInterpret 2.0 API.
blocks.zh: 图7:FLEURS EN-ZH测试集样本的翻译时间可视化. 该时间线说明了我们模式的耐久优势,它执行精细的,文字级的适应性翻译,与种子LiveInterpret 2.0 API采用的粗糙的,条款级的缓冲策略形成对比.

blocks.en: E.2 End-to-End Translation Timing Comparison
blocks.zh: E.2 终到终翻译时间比较

blocks.en: Furthermore, we visualize the end-to-end translation timing of a specific case from the FLEURS EN-ZH test set to compare our approach directly with the Seed LiveInterpret 2.0 API.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们从FLEURS EN-ZH测试集中可视化一个具体案例的端到端翻译时间,以直接比较我们的方法与种子LiveInterpret 2.0 API.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 7 , Seed LiveInterpret 2.0 exhibits a strong preference for coarse-grained, clause-level translation, often waiting for larger chunks of speech context to accumulate before generating an output. Conversely, our proposed model performs fine-grained, adaptive translation at the word level. This allows our model to execute more immediate and flexible read/write decisions, thereby effectively reducing translation latency while maintaining high generation quality.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,Seed Live Interpret 2.0显示出强烈倾向于粗糙的,条款级的翻译,经常等待更大的语境积聚才能产生输出. 相反,我们提议的模式在文字层面作了精细、适应性的翻译。 这使得我们的模型能够执行更直接和更灵活的阅读/写决定,从而有效减少翻译的延迟,同时保持高生成质量.

blocks.en: Appendix G Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录G 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Our proposed CRESiST framework significantly advances simultaneous speech translation, which has the positive potential to break down cross-lingual barriers, facilitate global communication, and improve accessibility for non-native speakers or the hearing-impaired. However, we must also acknowledge potential negative societal impacts. First, like many LLM-based systems, our model may exhibit performance disparities across different demographics, potentially showing bias against non-standard accents or low-resource dialects. Relying on such systems in high-stakes scenarios (e.g., medical or legal settings) without human oversight could lead to critical misunderstandings. Furthermore, the extensive computational resources required for training such omni-modal LLMs contribute to a substantial carbon footprint. We encourage future research to address these fairness and efficiency challenges to ensure safe and equitable deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提议的CRESiST框架大大推进了同时翻译的语音翻译,这具有打破跨语言障碍、促进全球交流和改善非母语者或听力障碍者的无障碍环境的积极潜力。 然而,我们也必须承认潜在的负面社会影响。 第一,与许多基于LLM的系统一样,我们的模式可能显示不同人口结构的性能差异,可能显示对非标准口音或低资源方言的偏见。 依靠这种系统,在没有人类监督的情况下,在高卷场景(例如医疗或法律环境)中,可能导致严重的误解。 此外,培训这种全方位模式的有限责任公司所需的大量计算资源有助于形成大量的碳足迹。 我们鼓励今后开展研究,处理这些公平和效率挑战,以确保安全和公平的部署。
